easy: Feeling or showing thanks for something someone did.

ex.en: Mia was appreciative of the help her friend gave her.
ex.ko: 미아는 친구가 도와준 것에 고마워했다.

easy: Able to see and enjoy how good or beautiful something is.

ex.en: The appreciative crowd clapped for the singer.
ex.ko: 진가를 알아주는 관객들이 가수에게 박수를 보냈다.

easy: Shaped like a curve, like a rainbow.

ex.en: We walked through an arched doorway into the old castle.
ex.ko: 우리는 아치형 출입구를 지나 오래된 성 안으로 들어갔다.

easy: To go up, like climbing a hill or stairs.

ex.en: We ascended the hill to watch the sunset.
ex.ko: 우리는 해넘이를 보려고 언덕에 올랐다.

easy: To wrap a soft cloth around a cut or sore part of the body.

ex.en: Dad bandaged my knee after I fell off my bike.
ex.ko: 내가 자전거에서 넘어지자 아빠가 내 무릎에 붕대를 감아 주셨다.

easy: To cover a hurt part of the body with a strip of soft cloth.

ex.en: The nurse bandaged my sprained ankle.
ex.ko: 간호사 선생님이 내 삔 발목에 붕대를 감아 주셨다.

easy: Happy and sad at the same time.

ex.en: The last day of school felt bittersweet to me.
ex.ko: 학교 마지막 날은 기쁘면서도 섭섭했다.

easy: Tasting a little bitter and a little sweet.

ex.en: I love bittersweet chocolate.
ex.ko: 나는 달콤쌉싸름한 초콜릿을 아주 좋아한다.

easy: A sickness that makes plants dry up and die.

ex.en: Blight killed the leaves of our tomato plants.
ex.ko: 마름병 때문에 우리 토마토 잎이 다 말라 죽었다.

easy: Having parts that grow out in different directions, like a tree.

ex.en: The branching tree gave shade to our whole yard.
ex.ko: 가지가 넓게 뻗은 나무가 우리 마당 전체에 그늘을 만들어 주었다.

easy: Splitting into parts like the arms of a tree.

ex.en: We saw branching cracks in the ice on the pond.
ex.ko: 연못 얼음에 나뭇가지처럼 갈라진 금이 보였다.

easy: To swell or stick out past the usual shape.

ex.en: My pocket bulged with the shells I found at the beach.
ex.ko: 해변에서 주운 조개껍데기 때문에 내 주머니가 불룩해졌다.

easy: To be so full that the sides stick out.

ex.en: My backpack bulges with books.
ex.ko: 내 책가방은 책으로 불룩하다.

easy: Done with substances that scientists make, like cleaning liquids.

ex.en: The pool water is cleaned chemically.
ex.ko: 수영장 물은 화학 약품으로 깨끗하게 처리된다.

easy: In a way that has to do with the science of what things are made of.

ex.en: Water and juice are chemically different.
ex.ko: 물과 주스는 화학적으로 다르다.

easy: Happening at the same time by chance.

ex.en: Coincidentally, my friend and I wore the same shirt.
ex.ko: 공교롭게도 내 친구와 나는 같은 셔츠를 입고 있었다.

easy: The edges or limits of a place.

ex.en: Our dog must stay within the confines of the yard.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 마당 안에만 있어야 한다.

easy: Working very carefully and trying very hard to do a good job.

ex.en: Jin is a conscientious student who checks every answer.
ex.ko: 진은 모든 답을 확인하는 성실한 학생이다.

easy: Caring about doing what is right and fair.

ex.en: Telling the truth was a conscientious choice.
ex.ko: 진실을 말한 것은 양심에 따른 선택이었다.

easy: Made of tiny hard pieces with flat sides, like salt or ice.

ex.en: Salt and sugar are crystalline.
ex.ko: 소금과 설탕은 결정으로 되어 있다.

easy: Tricking people by telling lies.

ex.en: He felt sorry for his deceit and told the truth.
ex.ko: 그는 속인 것을 후회하고 진실을 말했다.

easy: To say strongly in public that something is bad or wrong.

ex.en: The mayor denounced littering at the park.
ex.ko: 시장은 공원에 쓰레기를 버리는 것을 강하게 비난했다.

easy: To say in front of everyone that someone or something is shameful.

ex.en: The students denounced the mean joke.
ex.ko: 학생들은 그 못된 농담을 규탄했다.

easy: Showing that you think badly of someone.

ex.en: It is unkind to make derogatory remarks about classmates.
ex.ko: 반 친구를 깎아내리는 말을 하는 것은 못된 짓이다.

easy: To knock a building down until it is flat on the ground.

ex.en: Workers dismantled the old barn next to our house.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 우리 집 옆의 낡은 헛간을 철거했다.

easy: To take something apart into its pieces.

ex.en: Dad dismantled the broken bike to fix it.
ex.ko: 아빠는 고장 난 자전거를 고치려고 분해했다.

easy: The act of taking something apart.

ex.en: The dismantling of the old clock took an hour.
ex.ko: 낡은 시계를 분해하는 데 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: Going toward the east.

ex.en: The eastward trail leads to the lake.
ex.ko: 동쪽으로 난 길은 호수로 이어진다.

easy: Pretty pictures or patterns sewn onto cloth with colorful thread.

ex.en: Grandma's embroidery of flowers is on my pillow.
ex.ko: 할머니가 꽃을 수놓은 자수가 내 베개에 있다.

easy: Something strange that you cannot explain.

ex.en: How the cookies vanished is still an enigma.
ex.ko: 쿠키가 어떻게 사라졌는지는 아직도 수수께끼다.

easy: A hard puzzle or problem to figure out.

ex.en: Our teacher gave us an enigma to solve.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리에게 풀어야 할 수수께끼를 내 주셨다.

easy: A feeling of being extremely happy and excited.

ex.en: Winning the race filled me with euphoria.
ex.ko: 달리기에서 이겨서 나는 희열로 가득 찼다.

easy: A computer program that blocks bad things from getting into a computer.

ex.en: A firewall helps keep our home computer safe.
ex.ko: 방화벽은 우리 집 컴퓨터를 안전하게 지켜 준다.

easy: Strong and powerful.

ex.en: The captain gave a forceful speech before the game.
ex.ko: 주장은 경기 전에 힘찬 연설을 했다.

easy: Clear and strong when you speak or act.

ex.en: She gave a forceful "no" when they asked her to cheat.
ex.ko: 그들이 속임수를 쓰자고 하자 그녀는 단호하게 안 된다고 말했다.

easy: Covered with lots of green plants that grow low on the ground.

ex.en: We had a picnic on the grassy hill.
ex.ko: 우리는 풀이 무성한 언덕에서 소풍을 했다.

easy: A thing you hang clothes on.

ex.en: I put my coat on a hanger.
ex.ko: 나는 코트를 옷걸이에 걸었다.

easy: The folded and sewn bottom edge of a piece of clothing.

ex.en: Mom sewed the hem of my pants.
ex.ko: 엄마가 내 바지 단을 꿰매 주셨다.

easy: The work of cleaning a home and keeping it in order.

ex.en: Everyone helps with housekeeping on Saturday.
ex.ko: 토요일에는 모두가 집안일을 돕는다.

easy: Slow movement of water through soil or sand.

ex.en: The infiltration of rainwater through the sand was slow.
ex.ko: 빗물이 모래를 통해 스며드는 속도는 느렸다.

easy: Very well, because you know someone or something closely.

ex.en: I know my best friend intimately.
ex.ko: 나는 가장 친한 친구를 속속들이 안다.

easy: To rest on your knees on the ground.

ex.en: I knelt down to tie my shoe.
ex.ko: 나는 신발 끈을 묶으려고 무릎을 꿇고 앉았다.

easy: Liquid or gas getting out of a container through a small hole.

ex.en: Leakage from the pipe made a puddle on the floor.
ex.ko: 파이프에서 물이 새서 바닥에 웅덩이가 생겼다.

easy: A weak spot in a rule that lets someone get around it.

ex.en: The kids found a loophole in the game rules.
ex.ko: 아이들은 게임 규칙의 허점을 찾아냈다.

easy: Giving off a soft, glowing light.

ex.en: The luminous moon lit up our backyard.
ex.ko: 빛나는 달이 우리 뒷마당을 환하게 비췄다.

easy: Being sick or weak because you do not eat enough good food.

ex.en: Malnutrition makes it hard for children to grow.
ex.ko: 영양실조는 아이들이 자라기 어렵게 만든다.

easy: A person who is very good at math.

ex.en: My aunt is a mathematician who loves puzzles.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 퍼즐을 좋아하는 수학자이다.

easy: Sounding sweet and nice to hear, like a song.

ex.en: The bird's melodic song woke me up.
ex.ko: 새의 아름다운 노랫소리에 잠이 깼다.

easy: Having to do with the tune of a song.

ex.en: The melodic part of the song is easy to hum.
ex.ko: 그 노래의 멜로디 부분은 흥얼거리기 쉽다.

easy: Very careful about every small detail.

ex.en: Lena is meticulous when she draws maps.
ex.ko: 레나는 지도를 그릴 때 아주 꼼꼼하다.

easy: Taking great care with every little part.

ex.en: The meticulous baker measured each cup of flour.
ex.ko: 꼼꼼한 제빵사는 밀가루를 한 컵씩 정확히 쟀다.

easy: Not bragging about yourself.

ex.en: Even after winning, she showed modesty and thanked her team.
ex.ko: 그녀는 우승하고도 겸손하게 팀에게 고마움을 전했다.

easy: Thin cloth with lots of tiny open holes.

ex.en: Netting over my bed keeps the mosquitoes away.
ex.ko: 침대 위의 모기장이 모기를 막아 준다.

easy: The end of a hose or pipe where water comes out.

ex.en: I pointed the nozzle at the flowers and watered them.
ex.ko: 나는 호스 끝을 꽃에 향하게 해서 물을 주었다.

easy: In sports, standing where the rules do not let you stand.

ex.en: The goal did not count because he was offside.
ex.ko: 그가 오프사이드여서 골이 인정되지 않았다.

easy: A mistake in sports, standing in a place where you are not allowed.

ex.en: The referee blew the whistle for an offside.
ex.ko: 심판이 오프사이드로 호루라기를 불었다.

easy: A very large amount, more than you need.

ex.en: We had a plethora of pizza at the party.
ex.ko: 파티에 피자가 너무 많이 있었다.

easy: Needed first, before you can do the next thing.

ex.en: You must pass the prerequisite class first.
ex.ko: 먼저 선수 과목을 통과해야 한다.

easy: To say how much or how many, using a number.

ex.en: Can you quantify how much rain fell today?
ex.ko: 오늘 비가 얼마나 왔는지 수치로 말할 수 있니?

easy: To go over numbers one more time to check.

ex.en: I recounted my coins to be sure.
ex.ko: 나는 확실히 하려고 동전을 다시 세었다.

easy: A shape with four sides and four square corners.

ex.en: Our classroom door is a rectangle.
ex.ko: 우리 교실 문은 직사각형이다.

easy: A new supply that fills an empty container again.

ex.en: I bought a refill for my pen.
ex.ko: 나는 볼펜 리필심을 샀다.

easy: In a way that has to do with faith and beliefs about God.

ex.en: The festival is religiously important to many families.
ex.ko: 그 축제는 많은 가족에게 종교적으로 중요하다.

easy: Doing something every time, without missing, and very carefully.

ex.en: I brush my teeth religiously every night.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 밤 빠짐없이 이를 닦는다.

easy: To remember something so well that it feels like it is happening again.

ex.en: Looking at photos, I relived our beach trip.
ex.ko: 사진을 보며 나는 바닷가 여행을 다시 경험했다.

easy: Giving you new energy and making you feel fresh.

ex.en: The renewing rain made the dry garden green.
ex.ko: 생기를 되찾아 주는 비가 마른 정원을 푸르게 만들었다.

easy: In a way that shows you can be trusted to do what you should.

ex.en: He cared for the class hamster responsibly.
ex.ko: 그는 책임감 있게 학급 햄스터를 돌보았다.

easy: To travel in a circle around something, like a planet around the sun.

ex.en: The moon revolves around the Earth.
ex.ko: 달은 지구 주위를 돈다.

easy: To turn a key or knob again so a toy or clock keeps going.

ex.en: I rewound my music box after it stopped.
ex.ko: 음악 상자가 멈추자 나는 태엽을 다시 감았다.

easy: Quiet and private, where few people go.

ex.en: We found a secluded beach with no one else on it.
ex.ko: 우리는 아무도 없는 한적한 해변을 찾았다.

easy: Dark because the sun is blocked.

ex.en: We walked along the shadowy path under the trees.
ex.ko: 우리는 나무 아래 그늘진 길을 걸었다.

easy: Hard to see clearly.

ex.en: I saw a shadowy shape in the fog.
ex.ko: 나는 안개 속에서 희미한 형체를 보았다.

easy: To stay away from someone or something on purpose.

ex.en: She shuns scary movies.
ex.ko: 그녀는 무서운 영화를 일부러 피한다.

easy: Leaning to one side, not straight.

ex.en: The picture on the wall was skewed.
ex.ko: 벽에 걸린 그림이 기울어져 있었다.

easy: Made less strong or harsh.

ex.en: After he said sorry, her softened voice sounded kind.
ex.ko: 그가 사과하자 그녀의 누그러진 목소리는 다정하게 들렸다.

easy: A grown-up male horse.

ex.en: The stallion ran across the field.
ex.ko: 수말이 들판을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: Your mother's husband when he is not your birth father.

ex.en: My stepfather teaches me to play catch.
ex.ko: 새아버지는 나에게 캐치볼을 가르쳐 주신다.

easy: Held back with great effort, like a laugh or a cough.

ex.en: She let out a strangled laugh in class.
ex.ko: 그녀는 수업 중에 억지로 참은 웃음을 터뜨렸다.

easy: A thick cloth with a picture woven into it.

ex.en: A big tapestry of a dragon hangs in the castle.
ex.ko: 성에는 용이 그려진 큰 태피스트리가 걸려 있다.

easy: Showing love and kindness in a gentle way.

ex.en: She petted the kitten with tenderness.
ex.ko: 그녀는 다정하게 아기 고양이를 쓰다듬었다.

easy: A sore feeling when you touch a part of the body.

ex.en: I felt tenderness in my arm where I fell.
ex.ko: 넘어진 팔을 만지면 아팠다.

easy: A small dog that is good at digging.

ex.en: Our terrier loves to dig in the garden.
ex.ko: 우리 테리어는 정원에서 땅 파기를 좋아한다.

easy: The years of life from age 30 to 39.

ex.en: My dad is in his thirties.
ex.ko: 우리 아빠는 30대이다.

easy: The years from 1930 to 1939.

ex.en: My great-grandmother was born in the thirties.
ex.ko: 우리 증조할머니는 1930년대에 태어나셨다.

easy: A plant with prickly leaves and purple flowers.

ex.en: Ouch! The thistle pricked my finger.
ex.ko: 아야! 엉겅퀴에 손가락이 찔렸다.

easy: The hard, flat part at the end of the short, thick finger on your hand.

ex.en: I hurt my thumbnail in the door.
ex.ko: 나는 문에 엄지손톱을 다쳤다.

easy: To touch someone lightly so that it makes them laugh.

ex.en: I tickled my sister's feet and she giggled.
ex.ko: 내가 동생의 발을 간지럽히자 동생이 킥킥 웃었다.

easy: Shaped like a tube, long and hollow.

ex.en: The tubular slide at the park is fun.
ex.ko: 공원의 관 모양 미끄럼틀은 재미있다.

easy: Doing flips and rolls, like in gymnastics.

ex.en: Tumbling class taught me to do a cartwheel.
ex.ko: 텀블링 수업에서 옆돌기를 배웠다.

easy: Having had little schooling.

ex.en: Long ago many people were uneducated because they could not go to school.
ex.ko: 옛날에는 학교에 갈 수 없어서 교육받지 못한 사람이 많았다.

easy: To take things or people off a car or truck and leave them.

ex.en: Mom stopped the car to unload us at school.
ex.ko: 엄마는 우리를 학교에 내려 주려고 차를 세우셨다.

easy: To take everything out of a truck, van, or box.

ex.en: We unloaded the van after the camping trip.
ex.ko: 캠핑 여행을 마치고 우리는 밴에서 짐을 내렸다.

easy: The work of taking things off a truck or ship.

ex.en: The unloading of the ship took all day.
ex.ko: 배의 하역 작업은 하루 종일 걸렸다.

easy: Having no name or sign on it.

ex.en: An unmarked box sat on our porch.
ex.ko: 표시가 없는 상자가 현관에 놓여 있었다.

easy: Not shared with the public yet.

ex.en: The singer played an unreleased song for her fans.
ex.ko: 가수는 팬들에게 아직 발표하지 않은 노래를 들려주었다.

easy: A big vase with a base or feet.

ex.en: Flowers grew from the tall urn on the porch.
ex.ko: 현관의 키 큰 항아리에서 꽃이 자랐다.

easy: To hit a ball before it bounces on the ground.

ex.en: She volleyed the ball back over the net.
ex.ko: 그녀는 공이 땅에 닿기 전에 네트 너머로 받아쳤다.

easy: To give up something on purpose.

ex.en: He waived his turn so his sister could go first.
ex.ko: 그는 자기 순서를 포기해서 여동생이 먼저 하게 했다.

easy: In a friendly and happy way.

ex.en: Grandpa greeted us warmly at the door.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 문 앞에서 우리를 따뜻하게 맞아 주셨다.

easy: In a way that keeps you warm.

ex.en: Dress warmly, because it is snowing.
ex.ko: 눈이 오니까 따뜻하게 입어라.

easy: Hair that curves softly and is not straight.

ex.en: My cousin has long wavy hair.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 긴 웨이브 머리를 하고 있다.

easy: Curvy and bumpy, going up and down.

ex.en: The wind made the lake's surface wavy.
ex.ko: 바람 때문에 호수 표면이 물결쳤다.

easy: Air that spins around fast in a tall column.

ex.en: A whirlwind picked up leaves in the yard.
ex.ko: 회오리바람이 마당의 낙엽을 날려 올렸다.

easy: Belonging to a rich, high-ranking old family.

ex.en: The aristocratic family lived in a huge castle.
ex.ko: 그 귀족 가문은 거대한 성에 살았다.

easy: In a way that has to do with living things and how they grow.

ex.en: A dog and a wolf are biologically related.
ex.ko: 개와 늑대는 생물학적으로 관련이 있다.

easy: Full of little bubbles that fizz.

ex.en: I like bubbling soda on a hot day.
ex.ko: 나는 더운 날 톡톡 쏘는 탄산음료가 좋다.

easy: Full of happy energy.

ex.en: She is a bubbling girl who is always laughing.
ex.ko: 그녀는 늘 웃는 활기찬 아이다.

easy: Making an exact copy of a living thing.

ex.en: Cloning made a sheep named Dolly.
ex.ko: 복제 기술로 돌리라는 이름의 양이 태어났다.

easy: The power to get things done or to change what people do.

ex.en: The class president has clout with the teacher.
ex.ko: 반장은 선생님께 영향력이 있다.

easy: Made to remember an important event or person.

ex.en: The school put up a commemorative plaque.
ex.ko: 학교는 기념 명판을 세웠다.

easy: A coin or stamp made to remember something special.

ex.en: Grandpa collects commemoratives like special stamps.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 특별 우표 같은 기념품을 모으신다.

easy: A strong pot used to melt things at very high heat.

ex.en: The scientist heated metal in a crucible.
ex.ko: 과학자는 도가니에서 금속을 가열했다.

easy: Hard to understand because the meaning is hidden.

ex.en: The treasure map had a cryptic message.
ex.ko: 보물 지도에는 수수께끼 같은 글이 적혀 있었다.

easy: Having a secret meaning that only some people know.

ex.en: The spy sent a cryptic note.
ex.ko: 스파이는 암호 같은 쪽지를 보냈다.

easy: Working hard and carefully without giving up.

ex.en: Mina is a diligent student who does her homework every day.
ex.ko: 미나는 매일 숙제를 하는 성실한 학생이다.

easy: Careful and hardworking when doing a job.

ex.en: A diligent ant carries food to its nest.
ex.ko: 부지런한 개미가 먹이를 집으로 나른다.

easy: To put someone or something at a lower level.

ex.en: The hotel was downgraded to two stars.
ex.ko: 그 호텔은 별 두 개로 등급이 낮아졌다.

easy: Quiet and lost in thoughts, as if in a dream.

ex.en: He had a dreamy look as he stared out the window.
ex.ko: 그는 창밖을 보며 꿈꾸는 듯한 표정을 지었다.

easy: A long fish that looks like a snake.

ex.en: An eel swam through the river grass.
ex.ko: 뱀장어가 강가 풀숲 사이로 헤엄쳤다.

easy: Before birth or hatching, at the very first stage of life.

ex.en: A chick is in its embryonic stage inside the egg.
ex.ko: 병아리는 알 속에서 배아 단계에 있다.

easy: Just starting to grow or form.

ex.en: Our club is still embryonic, with only three members.
ex.ko: 우리 동아리는 아직 초기 단계라 회원이 세 명뿐이다.

easy: A small picture used in messages to show feelings.

ex.en: I sent a smiley emoji to my friend.
ex.ko: 나는 친구에게 웃는 이모지를 보냈다.
